releaseNotes.summary: v0.9.5-beta adds RAG tool calls, api endpoints, scripts, ai session cache, token usage, and telemetry improvements
changes: converted `/api/ask` to SSE with live retrieval, context, tool, token, and completion events
added provider token usage reporting with input, output, and total token metadata
added visible input, output, and total token cards to the AI response
cached the last completed AI session in localStorage and restored it when returning to the AI page
excluded telemetry history from RAG status evidence to prevent unnecessary context and token growth
moved some code parsing functions into `server/lib/code-parser.js`
fixed the RAG not being able to detect `path.join(rootDir, ...)` references in code
added `npm run rag` for direct repository-RAG diagnostics and refreshed the documentation/UI
added 7 tools for the RAG to use (`getStatus`, `getCommands`, `getReleaseInfo`, `runCommand`, `getLogs`, `getMetrics`, `getRoutes`)
seperated telemetry history from /api/status into a seperate /api/telemetry and an SSE endpoint /api/telemetry/stream
fixed direct RAG tool execution for status, logs, and metrics by exporting the server tool context
moved telemetry charts to telemetry-only JSON and SSE payloads and removed telemetry history from status and admin summaries
added authenticated /api/admin/server-events with a seperate server events page and critical-event prioritisation
added server event search and status filtering, timestamps, improved admin event styling, and fixed blank 404 rendering

scripts.start: npm run build && npm run lint && concurrently --names "BOT,SERVER" "npm run bot" "node server/server.js"
scripts.build:preview: vite build --open --config server/client/vite.config.mjs && vite preview --config server/client/vite.config.mjs
